title: Quantum Quill
summary: A dependable place to plan a story, build its world, and keep writing. Novel writing comes first; the foundations should also serve other kinds of storytelling.
validation: November 16 release: writing history PR #5 and Word Finder PR #6 are deployed together at https://quantquill.io as ce88058. All five integration-head checks and all three merged-head workflows passed; the combined suite includes 509 tests/48 suites plus Chromium/WebKit editor, save/recovery and restore checks. The independent paired database/upload backup was restored and verified before additive migrations 0007/0008; repeat runs and old/new application startup passed. Post-deploy original writing/account rows and upload/access files match the backup. HTTPS health, anonymous history access denial and exact deployed app/dictionary asset checks passed. These are release and fixture checks, not a new hosted-manuscript edit or physical iPad acceptance. Automatic releases, storage autoscaling and history deletion remain off. MCP PR #2 remains draft pending desktop conversational acceptance.

features.title: Writing you can recover
features.summary: Keep drafts through failed saves and reloads, with explicit choices when another tab or device has newer writing.
scope: Account/project-scoped durable draft journals and serialized autosave.
Server revisions, restore/discard review and protected navigation/export.
features.boundary: Draft recovery protects unsaved work; durable saved-version browsing is now available separately in QQ-31. This is not full offline app loading.
features.acceptance: Offline edits remain recoverable; reconnect cannot silently replace newer server writing; switching accounts cannot reveal another account's drafts.
features.evidence: docs/DRAFT_RECOVERY_AND_DATA_INTEGRITY.md; save, recovery and conflict suites; included in verified alpha release d610409. November 15 regression testing used fictional fixtures; this is not a new per-feature hosted manuscript edit.

features.title: One dependable data contract
features.summary: Use shared validation and classification while retaining every original field and legacy payload.
scope: Shared catalog, type-specific validation and compatibility readers are in place.
Versioned v2 documents and a disposable migration/rollback rehearsal are prepared.
features.boundary: 47 recovered records and 828 audited field paths were retained in rehearsal. Activation and ambiguous conversions have not been applied.
features.acceptance: Each recovered field has a documented destination or retained payload; reviewed migration and rollback preserve counts and values.
features.evidence: docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md; docs/DATA_CONTRACT_REHEARSAL.md

features.title: Relationships that stay connected
features.summary: Connect all seven entry types by identity, with roles, context, dates and useful backlinks.
scope: Shared searchable relationship picker, safe stubs and current target names.
Event participation/consequences, group membership, location governance/history and world-element usage/references.
features.boundary: Same-project validation, hierarchy cycle checks and archive/delete guards work. A visual graph is a separate later feature.
features.acceptance: Create, edit, remove and rename-target round trips retain meaning; invalid targets/cycles are rejected; linked deletion has predictable behavior.
features.evidence: docs/SHARED_RELATIONSHIPS.md; relationship API and field suites; included in verified alpha release d610409. November 15 regression testing used fictional fixtures; this is not a new per-feature hosted manuscript edit.

scope: Recoverable New Project Wizard and restored Blueprint Wizard.
Create project structure and scenes without replacing existing prose.
Eight plot-structure guides with optional embedded explainer videos and external fallbacks; viewing guidance does not change the selected structure.
features.boundary: Planning remains optional and wizard drafts stay protected. External video availability can vary by publisher or region; every guide retains a fallback. Playback of every source was not recertified in this release.
features.acceptance: Wizard progress is recoverable and repeatable; direct-to-writing remains a first-class path.
features.evidence: docs/WIZARDS_AND_SCENES.md; later stabilization closeout supersedes its old limitations; included in verified alpha release d610409. November 15 regression testing used fictional fixtures; this is not a new per-feature hosted manuscript edit. Plot-guide PR #1; combined viewer/selection/close walkthrough passed.

scope: Scene planning and story beats connect the Storyboard, Outline and Write workflows.
Existing outline notes and chapter-only writing remain available.
features.boundary: Planning is optional. The complete journey still needs more sustained real-project usability testing.
features.acceptance: A writer can start at any stage, follow a planned scene into Write and retain plans separately from prose.
features.evidence: docs/SCENE_OUTLINE_WORKFLOW.md; planning and scene-beat tests; included in verified alpha release d610409. November 15 regression testing used fictional fixtures; this is not a new per-feature hosted manuscript edit.

features.title: Shape the manuscript safely
features.summary: Reorder chapters and scenes, move scenes between chapters, and keep their writing intact.
scope: Persisted chapter/scene ordering with atomic moves and stale-arrangement checks.
Safe chapter rename/completion and guarded chapter deletion.
features.boundary: Scene deletion and automatic conversion between chapter writing modes are not exposed.
features.acceptance: Moving/reordering preserves prose, scene plans and references; conflicting arrangements are rejected without partial updates.
features.evidence: docs/STABILIZATION_CLOSEOUT.md; manuscript API and PostgreSQL rehearsal; included in verified alpha release d610409. November 15 regression testing used fictional fixtures; this is not a new per-feature hosted manuscript edit.

Premade typographic styles and account-level custom saved styles.
features.boundary: This is not a paginated publishing engine. Footnotes, headers/footers and tracked changes remain outside the current editor.
features.acceptance: Formatting and custom styles survive save/reload, export within documented limits and draft recovery.
features.evidence: docs/WRITE_FORMATTING.md; formatting, style and export tests; included in verified alpha release d610409. November 15 regression testing used fictional fixtures; this is not a new per-feature hosted manuscript edit.

Create an unfinished entry with only a name and type; develop it through Start here and optional field groups, with examples that never become authored content.

Combined release: 464 tests/44 suites, 265-binding comparison, 16 synthetic Chromium checks across all seven entry types, GitHub production-style database/restore and browser checks passed.

Verified HTTPS sessions, writing saves, conflict rejection, account/image isolation, export and writing/uploads retained across deployment.
Automatic service releases and Blueprint sync are off. The reviewed base hosting cost is $13.55/month; usage overages remain possible.
features.boundary: Early alpha: email verification, password-reset email and self-service account deletion are not available. Public database access and storage autoscaling are disabled. Upstream editor/validation dependency upgrades remain tracked with scoped safeguards.
features.acceptance: Staging passes real writer flows and account isolation; database/uploads restore is proven; costs and rollback are reviewed before release.
features.evidence: Verified alpha https://quantquill.io, release ce88058 on November 16. PRs #5/#6 and all merged-head checks passed. Migrations 0007/0008 were applied after independent paired backup/restore rehearsal, with original rows and uploads unchanged. Previous code starts against the additive schema for rollback; rolling back code does not capture new history. Database storage was 8.49% of its 1 GB disk at review; uploads were about 16 MB. The three-day provider recovery window was available. Monday PM reviews now include capacity and backup freshness; no new paid resources, automatic pruning or database exposure.

features.title: Private tester feedback
features.summary: Report bugs, confusing experiences and ideas from inside QQ without leaving your writing.
scope: Private report form with category, summary, details and app area; optional browser information and email follow-up.
Account-scoped report receipts and recent history. Unsent feedback survives reload in the current browser tab; retries avoid duplicate reports.
No prose, project names, screenshots or account secrets are attached automatically. Reports are visible only to their writer and the maintainer.
Private admin inbox with report search, category/status filters, pagination and detailed review. Status updates appear in the tester’s own report history; stale changes are rejected.
features.boundary: Admin inbox is live with explicitly provisioned maintainer access. This permission covers feedback only; it does not grant access to other writers’ manuscripts. No automatic email notifications or live-support response promise. Twenty new reports per account per day.
features.acceptance: Live submission, privacy between accounts, idempotent retry, persisted history and unchanged writing verified; feedback survives the paired database restore.
features.evidence: Private report release f0b8bba; admin inbox feature 7a3f09d. 391 tests / 38 suites, production PostgreSQL checks, 18-table restore and synthetic browser review passed. Owner access activated on October 24; anonymous access denied. See docs/FEEDBACK.md.

features.title: Revisit and restore writing versions
features.summary: Visible Undo/Redo and durable chapter or scene history are available in the alpha, with preview, comparison and deliberate restoration.
scope: Visible Undo/Redo, saved prose history, formatted preview/compare and explicit restoration as a new current revision. Existing recovery and account/project/document boundaries remain in force.
Keep this version and protected restore checkpoints preserve selected, outgoing and restored versions; exact version download is available.

History begins with changed saves after this release; earlier drafts are not retroactively reconstructed. Retention is dry-run only: actual expiry requires separate review and implementation. Physical iPad/software-keyboard and assistive-technology acceptance remain open. Version history supplements independent backups.
features.acceptance: A writer can undo/redo edits and inspect/restore a saved version without losing current work, formatting or inline references. Restore creates a new current revision, respects account/project access and conflicts, and survives reload.
features.evidence: November 16: PR #5 (https://github.com/drsurfbum/quantum-quill-app/pull/5) merged as ce88058 and deployed to quantquill.io. Five checks at integration head 134028e and three workflows at the merge passed; 509 tests/48 suites, combined Chromium/WebKit Word Finder/history/save-recovery checks and synthetic 19-table paired restore. The actual pre-release backup restored exactly, both migrations and repeat runs passed, and old/new builds started against the migrated copy. Post-deploy health, auth boundaries, asset checks and unchanged original data/uploads passed. See docs/WRITING_VERSION_HISTORY.md. This does not claim a new hosted-manuscript restore or physical-device test.

features.title: Find the right word while writing
features.summary: An English dictionary and thesaurus is available inside Write, with sense-grouped results and explicit, undoable replacement.
scope: Look up selected text or a typed English word or expression; show definitions, sense-grouped synonyms/antonyms, examples and related concepts.

Pinned, attributed Open English WordNet 2025 data is self-hosted as static compressed shards. Lookup runs in the browser; requests use a bucket identifier rather than a lookup word or surrounding manuscript.

Choosing a result previews it. Only Replace selection changes prose, preserves supported formatting and creates its own Undo/Redo step. Stale selections, changed scenes and semantic links block unsafe replacement.

Word Finder, visible Undo/Redo, History, inline Bible linking and the full formatting controls coexist in the fixed-height toolbar. Combined chapter/scene checks preserve selection guards and save/recovery behavior.
features.boundary: Live with writing history in ce88058. English only; modern DecompressionStream support is required. Dataset coverage varies; rhymes and sound-based discovery are not delivered. Physical iPad/software-keyboard acceptance remains open. No external lookup provider, new database, hosting service, package dependency or app version bump is included.
features.acceptance: A writer can find a useful alternative without losing cursor position, formatting, save status or prose space. Results state their source; loading, no-match and unavailable states work. Any replacement is deliberate and undoable.
features.evidence: November 16: PR #6 (https://github.com/drsurfbum/quantum-quill-app/pull/6) merged as 3daa3fc and released in ce88058 after combined history integration. All final integration/merged-head workflows passed. Chromium/WebKit fixtures cover chapter/scene replacement, formatting, visible undo/redo, history restore, pending/failed saves, stale selections and navigation. Live app assets, dictionary manifest and a lookup bucket exactly match the reviewed build; anonymous history access is denied. See docs/WORD_FINDER.md for data provenance and limitations. Fixture interaction results are not a new hosted manuscript edit.
